newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Vacuum suspends morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Vacuum suspends morning trade.

text.p: Trading of Shanghai Vacuum and Electron Devices Co Ltd was suspended on Thursday morning after it announced that ownership of all its state shares had been transferred, brokers said.
Trading in the stock would resumed in the afternoon session, the broking sources said.

Shanghai Vacuum said its state shares had been transferred to Shanghai Video and Audio Electric (Group) Co from former owner state-owned Shanghai Electric Meters (Group) Co, whose ultimate parent is the Shanghai city government.
Shanghai Vacuum has a total of 237.8391 million state shares, making up 44.78 percent of the firm's 531.0876 million outstanding shares.
Shanghai Vaccum is a television display tube maker.
The company reported a profit of 121.08 million yuan in 1995 and an interim of 3.71 million yuan in mid-1996.
